isolated_evidence.comparison_limit: Microbenchmarks and progressively played tournaments are not a controlled end-to-end A/B test.

latest_scoped_cache_evidence.tablet_allocation: Eight player-only status messages: before 18 full-allocation getter reads versus after 2, preserving the initial cache; five actual operator/court/activity changes still invalidate and yield the correct court.
latest_scoped_cache_evidence.speech_inventory: Before: new free-text and single-game tracking eagerly mapped every game. After: free text and fully hidden controls do not read the game inventory; initial single-game tracking searches without allocating an inventory; shared visible refresh creates one lazy Map and retains last-duplicate precedence.

loaf_analysis_correction: Early temporary console summaries incorrectly treated a missing aggregate script_duration_ms field as zero. Raw exported frames retain scripts[].duration_ms. Run23 point202 has 105.4 ms total frame duration and 85.6 ms script, not 105.4 ms pure paint. Pure paint claims require separate native trace evidence.

final_planner_serialization.scope: Only local auto_call and auto_preparation planning share a per-database/per-tournament promise tail before snapshots. No foreground resource lock is held; other tournaments remain independent, and failures release the tail.
final_planner_serialization.run25_original_error: BTP sync changed repeatedly while waiting; retry on next fetch

name_visibility_overhead_control.comparison_limit: One paired isolated 100-point sample: median/max similar, total TaskDuration higher with visibility tracking, ScriptDuration/LayoutDuration lower. This does not establish a total CPU reduction. Both probes completed within the standard idle phase.

storage_evidence.semantics: The actual existing appendFileSync call was observed; open/close phases were negligible. No update was published before persistence.

worker_priority.scope: Linux only; four explicitly named calculation workers nice 5, main/append thread priority retained.

rejected_battery_layers.reason: Neither paint containment nor compositor layers gave a useful repeatable latency reduction; layers increased total task cost. Animation remains unchanged.

rejected_transport_experiment.reason: Native TLS writes were below 3 ms for 0.5–2 MiB messages. Fragmentation made bulk responses slower and did not explain the 50+ ms stalls.
rejected_transport_experiment.scope: Own isolated HTTPS/WebSocket server and separate tiny-message receiver, only during the standard idle phase.

test_oracle_note: Only the deliberately quadratic 519-game correctness oracle has a 10-second Mocha timeout after two spurious 2-second timeouts. Exact read-count/decision assertions and all strict end-to-end latency limits are unchanged.
visibility_semantics: Startup retains the complete first fit. Subsequent native fitting of already observed groups more than 600px outside the viewport is deferred until approach. DOM status and resource badges still update immediately. The native regression verifies deferred name/font changes and correct labels after scrolling. Without IntersectionObserver the original full fitting remains.

final_causal_windows.interpretation: Sampling durations may include descheduling and are not exclusive CPU time. The (program) bucket does not identify an exact native function. Nested work must not be added as independent costs. Frame script durations are read from scripts[]; remaining frame time is not automatically paint CPU.

remaining_limits: Finite test repetitions do not establish a hard real-time guarantee on the operating system or physical clients.
A diagnostic sampling duration can include descheduling and must not be described as exact exclusive CPU time.
Production database files remain on their original persistent filesystem.
